photo_cues: visible empty wall, nearby power outlet, normal ceiling
recommended_placement: place cake table centered on the cleanest wall with backdrop behind
traffic_rule: avoid door swing and main seating path

photo_cues: large focal wall or stage, high ceiling, formal tables
recommended_placement: use a centered stage or focal wall; keep service route behind or beside guest tables
traffic_rule: minimum 120 cm public aisle; follow venue code
lighting_rule: two soft front lights plus warm backdrop wash
confidence_blockers: unknown stage load;unknown ceiling rigging;emergency exit behind setup

photo_cues: level ground, shade options, weather exposure
recommended_placement: place on level hard surface under cover; orient backdrop away from strongest wind
traffic_rule: use weighted bases outside walking route
lighting_rule: diffused daylight;avoid direct afternoon sun on cake

photo_cues: open skyline, wind exposure, limited anchors
recommended_placement: use low-profile weighted decor and keep cake within sheltered zone
traffic_rule: keep clear of railings, exits, and service doors

photo_cues: water edge, reflective surface, humid air
recommended_placement: place cake on non-slip dry deck at least 2 m from water
traffic_rule: keep 120 cm dry path and barriers for children

photo_cues: brand wall, reception route, screens, cables
recommended_placement: place brand and cake/display zone where visible from entrance but outside check-in queue

photo_cues: fixed tables, narrow aisles, service traffic
recommended_placement: use compact backdrop and cake stand beside reserved table, not in server path
traffic_rule: preserve staff service access and accessible aisle
lighting_rule: use window light plus small battery lamp

photo_cues: open floor, brick or concrete wall, tall windows
recommended_placement: create one strong focal wall and leave architecture visible
traffic_rule: define photo queue outside main aisle
lighting_rule: warm side light;control harsh window backlight

photo_cues: fabric walls, modular floor, service entrances
recommended_placement: use weighted freestanding structures; never rely on tent fabric as load support
traffic_rule: keep tent exits and catering access fully clear
lighting_rule: warm LEDs mounted only by approved vendor

photo_cues: large open floor, sports markings, wall bars
recommended_placement: use low stable props and a clearly bounded photo/cake area
traffic_rule: separate active play from cake and decor
confidence_blockers: unsecured sports equipment;small loose parts;blocked fire door

recommended_placement: use a stable platform and covered cake display; choose low decor
traffic_rule: maintain public access and protect from tide line
lighting_rule: early morning or sunset;avoid direct sun

photo_cues: perspective unclear, no scale object, cropped room
recommended_placement: give concept-only placement and request dimensions or a second angle before scale claims
confidence_blockers: no scale reference;hidden exits;single narrow image
